subject: Urgent: Exhibit crate detained at port — immediate paperwork needed

Subject: HOLD - Container 78TKU145 detained by customs

Hi Camila / Dev,

Quick heads up — your inbound container (78TKU145) arriving at Port Wilmington has been placed on a customs hold pending additional commercial documentation. Customs specifically flagged a missing importer EORI/ID and an unsigned commercial invoice. Without this the crate cannot be released to the forwarder.

Attached: BOL_Atlas_11302026.pdf (bill of lading)

What we need from Redwood immediately:
- Signed commercial invoice (scanned PDF)
- Confirmation of importer ID/EIN or EORI if applicable
- If you want Atlas to appoint a broker on your behalf, we need written POA

If we don’t get the paperwork within 6 business hours, the container will move to a bonded yard and additional demurrage/storage charges will apply. Current ETA to port gate is 11/14 07:00 local.

Options: redirect to Atlas advance warehouse near the port (we can unload to pallet racking) or submit paperwork and clear at terminal. Let us know preferred path.

Regards,
Peter Morales
Atlas Logistics — Operations
ops@atlaslogistics.com
[Attachment: BOL_Atlas_11302026.pdf]
